items.title: Property Vault
items.problem: Buyers still needed a broker in the middle because they could not trust documents or payments on their own.
items.solution: React and Flask with a MySQL property passport — ownership, tax, RERA — Razorpay for a flat verification fee, Docker for deploy.
items.outcome: Buyer and seller deal directly. Documents stay stored and only surface when the checklist says they should.
items.description: React and Flask real estate platform. MySQL property passport (ownership, tax, RERA), Razorpay verification payments, Docker.

items.title: Personalized Learning System
items.problem: Students sat the same test whether they already knew the material or not.
items.solution: A React front end and Flask API that writes tests, grades them, and feeds the next round from Gemini and Llama 3.2.
items.outcome: 3rd place at VEDHA, hosted by VVCE IEEE CIS and CSE (AI & ML).
items.description: A React and Flask exam platform that writes tests, grades them, and adapts the next set with Gemini and Llama 3.2. Third at VEDHA.

items.title: Supernest.ai Finance
items.problem: The app needed a finance module that talked to the backend and did not feel like a settings dump.
items.solution: Flutter screens with Provider, REST, and motion, shipped as a self-contained module.
items.outcome: Live on the Play Store. 50+ downloads, 5.0 rating.
items.description: Finance module in Flutter (Provider, REST, motion). Live on the Play Store — 50+ downloads, 5.0 rating.

items.title: Blox
items.problem: People using the app had no way to talk to each other inside it.
items.solution: Firebase chat with reactions, replies, deletes, stickers, and images, plus a notifications module in Flutter.
items.outcome: Live on the Play Store. 100+ downloads, 4.3 rating.
items.description: In-app chat on Firebase — reactions, replies, stickers, images — and a notifications module in Flutter. Play Store, 100+ downloads, 4.3.

story: I studied Computer Science and Business Systems at JSS Science and Technology University in Mysuru. I interned at MediBuddy, Supernest.ai, and Schaffen, then joined Infosys as a Specialist Programmer in October 2025.
At Infosys I split Java and Flask services into Node and Express microservices, cut API latency 35%, and put Jest and Docker/Jenkins on the path to production. Defects dropped 40% over two quarters.
At MediBuddy I shipped Vision Care — React and Express, thousands of daily users, health data. I moved Angular modules to Next.js, cached peak traffic with Redis, and cut LCP 54%.
